purpose: Reviewer preparation only; not a scored reference or independent acceptance.
input_boundary: Never upload reference/ or pass these notes, source inspection findings, or expected answers to the product model.
candidate_boundary: Candidate remains frozen for the first evaluation. Changing prompts, retrieval or rules using these notes consumes this pack for development; use a new holdout to claim generalization.
scoring_boundary: These notes are semantic review guidance, not the exact-match scorer input. An independent reviewer must resolve scope, conditions, wording equivalence and disagreements before freezing a new scored reference and plan.

assessment_legend.supported: Frozen text establishes the listed claims; conditions still apply.
assessment_legend.partial: Some facts are visible; listed missing items must remain unknown.
assessment_legend.not_found: No admissible evidence for the requested fact was found in the inspected frozen text.
assessment_legend.conflicting_or_conditional: Source statements differ or have unresolved scope/conditions; preserve both without inventing precedence.
assessment_legend.unreliable_extraction: Relevant labels exist but extraction lost the content or plan mapping.
